title: Pre-Market Brief — 01 Sep 2026
intro: US equity futures trade lower as geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz push oil higher and unsettle markets, with tech under pressure following Amazon's FTC lawsuit.

sections.heading: 🌅 SNAPSHOT
sections.content: US equity futures trade lower as geopolitical tensions in the Strait of Hormuz push oil higher and unsettle markets, with tech under pressure following Amazon's FTC lawsuit.

sections.heading: 📊 FUTURES
sections.content:
S&P 500: $767.05, -0.30%, testing support at $765
Nasdaq: 26371, -0.12%, holding above 26300
Dow: 53186, -0.70%, weakness in industrials dragging index below 53200

sections.heading: 🎯 TOP MOVERS
sections.content:
TSLA $367.95 +5.51% — strong delivery data speculation ahead of quarter-end — resistance at $375
NVDA $220.78 +1.48% — AI demand resilience — holding $220 support
AMZN $259.77 -2.50% — FTC lawsuit over ad practices pressuring shares — testing $255 support
GOOGL $339.35 -2.09% — tech sector weakness and regulatory concerns spilling over — watch $335

sections.heading: 🏦 SECTOR THEME
sections.content:
Energy outperforms on oil surge while mega-cap tech lags on regulatory headwinds and rate concerns following higher mortgage rates.
📰 CATALYSTS
US airstrikes near Strait of Hormuz | Overnight | Oil rally, geopolitical risk premium rising
Amazon FTC lawsuit expansion | Ongoing | Regulatory pressure on big tech intensifies
Mortgage rates rising | Today | Housing sector concerns, rate-sensitive equities under pressure

sections.heading: ⚠️ RISKS
sections.content: Escalation in Middle East could spike oil further and pressure consumer spending. VIX up 10% signals rising hedging demand; watch forbreak above 16 confirming defensive positioning.
